description: Transactional replication health: latency, pending commands, Dist/LogReader/Snapshot agents, inventory, and local REPL SQL Agent jobs.

targets.expr: max by (instance, publisher_db, subscriber_db, agent_name, subscription_type) (mssql_replication_distribution_agent_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", subscription_type=~"${subscription_type:regex}"})

max by (instance, publisher_db, subscriber_db, agent_name, subscription_type) (mssql_replication_distributor_latency_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", subscription_type=~"${subscription_type:regex}"})

max by (instance, publisher_db, subscriber_db, agent_name, subscription_type) (mssql_replication_distribution_agent_last_run_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", subscription_type=~"${subscription_type:regex}"})

max by (instance, publisher_db, subscriber_db, agent_name, subscription_type) (mssql_replication_distribution_delivered_commands{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", subscription_type=~"${subscription_type:regex}"})
max by (instance, publisher_db, publication, agent_name) (mssql_replication_snapshot_agent_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, publisher_db, publication, agent_name) (mssql_replication_snapshot_agent_last_run_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Local REPL SQL Agent Jobs (Pull / mixed)

targets.expr: max by (instance, agent_role, category_name, job_name) (mssql_replication_agent_job_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, agent_role, category_name, job_name) (mssql_replication_agent_job_running{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, agent_role, category_name, job_name) (mssql_replication_agent_job_last_run_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (instance, agent_role, category_name, job_name) (mssql_replication_agent_job_last_run_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})

title: Collector replication
